title: Trove home sensor reading
description: One line of home/<source>/YYYY-MM.jsonl: a scalar reading from an owned sensor/device. Shares its four-field core (ts, source, metric, value) with environment readings so the two merge at read time. Additive evolution: readers tolerate unknown fields.

ts.description: RFC3339 local time the reading was taken

source.description: collector id; identical to the source folder name (lowercase/digits/dash)

metric.description: what was measured, snake_case: temperature, humidity, co2, pm25, pm10, radon, voc, noise_db, pressure, aqi, uv, water_level, … — kept stable so it lines up with environment readings

value.description: the numeric reading (unit rides in the unit field)

unit.description: unit of value: C, F, percent, ppm, ug_m3, bq_m3, db, hpa, aqi, index, … — omit only when truly unitless

place.description: human label of where: room name or station name

device.description: the owned device/sensor id or name (home-specific)

lat.description: latitude in degrees, when the device reports it (outdoor PWS)

lon.description: longitude in degrees, when the device reports it (outdoor PWS)
